Name: (discontinued) Traveling Takes Time
Author: Vrakyas
Description:
[u][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][/u]

[color=#ff0000][b][size=4]DISCONTINUED! I won't update this anymore![/size][/b][/color]

With this mod traveling by mine cart or bus will take some time. The time depends on the distance you're traveling:
[list]
[*]Bus stop <--> Mines: 20mins
[*]Mines <--> Quarry: 10mins
[*]Quarry <--> Town: 20mins
[*]Bus stop <--> Desert: 30mins
[/list]If you travel multiple steps, the time will stack, e.g. from Bus stop to town it will take 50mins (20+10+20).
You can set the time costs directly in the config.json in the mod folder.


[u][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color][/u]

[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and install this mod (download with Vortex possible and recommended)
[*]Start SV and load up a save game or start a new game
[*]Edit settings via console command as desired
[/list]

[u][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/u]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.36+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Stardew Valley Modding API (SMAPI) 2.9+[/url]﻿
[/list]

[u][size=4][b][color=#ffd966]Console command usage[/color][/b][/size][/u]

[font=Courier New]Usage: ttt <command> <parameter>
<command>    one of the following:
 help        show this help
 show        show currently active options
 reset       reset options back to default values
 verbose     true|false: enable verbose logging
<parameter>  one of the following for verbose:
 true        enables an option
 false       disables an option
Examples:
 ttt verbose true   enable verbose logging
 ttt reset          resets all settings back to default
Notice: Currently it's not possible to set the timecosts via SMAPI console command![/font]
